title: HHS poverty guidelines, 2024
description: Complete published eight-person schedules for the contiguous states/DC, Alaska and Hawaii, with the additional-person increments.
geography: Three separately published geographic schedules; Ohio uses the contiguous-states/DC schedule
methodology: Values are retained as published in the original HHS notice. The guidelines simplify Census thresholds for administrative use and use programme-specific definitions of income, family and applicability. They are not SPM thresholds or the Census statistical grid.

source.title: Annual Update of the HHS Poverty Guidelines, 2024
source.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services / Government Publishing Office
